title: Overlord: Sei Oukoku-hen - Manner Movie
content:
I’m not a big theater fan, I guess I can blame that on where I come from. Not much good cinemas and subpar content to show for it, so it always struck me weird seeing all these Anime movies having dedicated animations with the characters specifically breaking the fourth wall to address very seemingly common issues that may happen during the screening.

What’s even weirder is how this one gets its own entry in MAL’s database, because you know, you can just experience it as part of the movie itself, it comes packaged in already.

Either way, for me at least, having been a long time sinceI last saw anything Overlord related, it was great to see Ainz, Albedo and Demiurge banter together and announcing hilariously harsh medieval punishments towards the audience for the smallest of things.

I guess you’ll be missing nothing if you decide to go without seeing or paying attention to this part of the movie, you’d probably be arriving late or maybe still adjusting properly in your seat, but this is here for the people who want it. Completely optional.

Overall: 5.8/10.
